analysis: Cognitive master, device mapping and initial SQL discovery
cohort: 83 cognitive records; early longitudinal candidate count 62
methods_features_outcomes: NeuroTrax Global, memory, executive function, processing speed, attention, motor, verbal and IQ; special-code and delta QC; device/time inventories
findings_limitations: Created cognitive master, mapping and bounded extraction eligibility; mapped/active subsets differ from the source cohort. No cognitive association inferred from availability.

analysis: Early daily movement and frequency/power pilots
cohort: 2 rows in daily_movement_summary; 971 in daily_signal_power_from_significant_days; these are not patient counts
methods_features_outcomes: Daily squared-magnitude aggregation; first significant-day signal powers, Butterworth/Welch exploratory spectral summaries
findings_limitations: Saved engineering outputs exist; no saved cognitive effect, p/q/CI or validated activity label. Script existence does not prove every optional activity_analysis.py mode was executed.

analysis: Phase 1 top-decline proof of concept
cohort: 10 selected; baseline usable 8; early/late change 2
methods_features_outcomes: Early/late seven-day availability; screen/app logs, keyboard/touch and activity; descriptive phenotype axes
findings_limitations: Rich table 10×79 and six descriptive engagement/nighttime/app/interaction/activity/quality axes. Early–late evidence extremely limited and cohort selected on decline.

analysis: Phase 2 feature review, SQL fieldwork and high-T1 pilots
cohort: Initial review snapshot 29 selected features/27 calculable values; later active extraction 81
methods_features_outcomes: Schema/JSON and privacy review across keyboard, apps, battery, calls, messages, GSM, locations, touch, screen, sensors; highest-T1 36h and bounded sample pilots
findings_limitations: Engineering feasibility, not a prediction study. The initial feature counts are historical snapshots, not the final bank. Raw identifiers/content not model variables.

analysis: Phase 2/3 24h and adjusted seven-day extraction
cohort: 81 active T1 patients; coverage varies by feature
methods_features_outcomes: Day after T1, then first valid 24h in T1 week; first-available seven-day barometer/significant-motion/linear-sensor sensitivities
findings_limitations: 71 selected columns feed Phase 4; 37 primary, 15 adjusted, 17 low-coverage, 2 entirely missing in documented Phase 4 construction. Availability anchors differ across modalities.

analysis: Phase 3 calls and Bluetooth extended-window R&D
cohort: 82 status rows per pilot
methods_features_outcomes: Calls whole 7/14/30-day post-T1 windows; Bluetooth 7/30 days; any-data coverage sensitivities
findings_limitations: Calculated calls: 6/82, 11/82, 12/82; Bluetooth: 1/82 in both windows. Longer windows did not solve absent streams. No predictive inference.

analysis: ACC metadata, hardware, raw 24h and minute probes
cohort: Metadata: general ACC 77/81, linear sensor 31/81; local raw pilot one window
methods_features_outcomes: Hardware timelines, raw/metadata alignment, 24h chunked signal QC, PSD/band feasibility and thresholds; calendar-minute SQL probes
findings_limitations: Local pilot 1,072,778 raw rows; 288 five-minute chunks (287 signal-valid). Phone-state labels and frequency bands are provisional; metadata availability is not raw-signal availability.

analysis: Phase 4 24h Global prediction and score calibration
cohort: 81; primary 37 plus sensitivity scopes
methods_features_outcomes: Repeated 5-fold ×20 Ridge/mean; gradient weighting, slope-selected and direction-constrained Ridge; elastic net, PLS/spline alternatives; calibration
findings_limitations: Global performance generally near/worse than mean. Historical pooled tables have outcome/prediction-order defects; review uses saved per-repeat rows. Calibration correlations are prediction diagnostics, not feature associations.

analysis: Phase 4 24h cognitive domains and domain feature groups
cohort: 71–81 outcome-specific; Motor n=79
methods_features_outcomes: Separate domain Ridge using primary features; expert domain-group panels
findings_limitations: Motor per-repeat Ridge RMSE 10.186 vs mean 10.678; mean R² .0559. Small exploratory advantage, no external validation; other domains often negative.

analysis: Phase 4 clustering, profiles and coverage audits
cohort: 81×37; high-coverage subset 53
methods_features_outcomes: Median imputation, standardized PCA, K-means k=2–5, 20 seeds; profiles, high-coverage and strict-feature sensitivities
findings_limitations: 24h k=2 silhouette .497 and seed ARI 1.00; high-coverage k=3 silhouette .404. Seed stability does not establish clinical groups; coverage-sensitive.

analysis: Phase 5 pre-T2 extraction
cohort: 61 represented; 17 tables; 71 selected features
methods_features_outcomes: First valid pre-T2 24h in prior week, latest fallback to 30 days; adjusted seven-day sensor windows
findings_limitations: Sparse follow-up coverage documented separately; absence remains missing. No model in extraction step.

analysis: Phase 6 independent T1/T2 scores and derived change
cohort: Up to 61 paired; domain-specific missingness
methods_features_outcomes: Independent endpoint Ridge/mean, then estimated T2−T1; 5-fold ×5 for T2
findings_limitations: Global T2 RMSE 8.534 working Ridge vs 8.164 mean; derived Global change 6.198 vs descriptive mean-change 5.738. Not a baseline-only prospective forecast; mean-change benchmark uses whole paired outcome mean.

analysis: Phase 7 10-day window extraction and coverage comparison
methods_features_outcomes: Availability-anchored ten-day windows vs 24h; same-feature coverage audit
findings_limitations: T1 missingness 38.5%→33.5% (50 common features); T2 76.2%→76.0% (61 common). More rows do not imply more covered patients.

analysis: 10-day Phase 4 models, domains, constraints and clustering
cohort: 81 source; 67 metadata features; 71–81 outcomes
methods_features_outcomes: Same baseline model families, all-direction constraint and k=2–5 clustering
findings_limitations: Processing-speed Ridge per-repeat RMSE 12.950 vs 13.718 mean; R² .0799, n=71. Cluster silhouette .528 (k=2). Pooled metrics require correction before use.

analysis: 10-day additional models and coverage-ranked suggestions
cohort: Full 81; prespecified coverage-ranked 30/20/10 subsets
methods_features_outcomes: Elastic net, PLS, spline Ridge, RF, ExtraTrees, hist-gradient and XGBoost; domain suggestions
findings_limitations: Best saved per-repeat result: top-10 Global elastic net RMSE 7.978 vs 10.454, R² .266; n=10 descriptive only. Top-20/30 do not reproduce that gain. Pooled .053 R² is affected by ordering defect.

analysis: 10-day Phase 6 independent endpoint/change sensitivity
cohort: Up to 61 paired
methods_features_outcomes: Reuse independent T2 and derived difference workflow on ten-day data
findings_limitations: Global T2 Ridge 8.195 vs mean 8.164; derived change 6.227 vs 5.738 descriptive mean. No clear improvement from longer acquisition.

analysis: Phase 11 first-half midpoint phenotype, models and clinical tables
cohort: 81; active feature metadata 54; target-specific n
methods_features_outcomes: [T1,midpoint), fallback T1+123d; model family reruns, clustering and median-severity comparison
findings_limitations: Global primary Ridge saved per-repeat RMSE 8.775 vs 8.647 mean. Two nominal keyboard median-split findings (p=.032/.036) fail FDR. Post-T1 data cannot serve as a genuinely pre-T1 predictor.

analysis: Phase 12 second-half midpoint endpoint/change analysis
cohort: 61 cognitive pairs, variable sensor coverage
methods_features_outcomes: [midpoint,T2); independent endpoint estimation; subtraction after modeling
findings_limitations: Global T2 working Ridge 8.267 vs 8.164 mean; derived change 6.159 vs 5.738 descriptive mean. Not prospective early-only forecasting.

analysis: Phase 111 full-interval representation and mean cognition
cohort: 81 source; domain-specific n
methods_features_outcomes: [T1,T2), otherwise 123d; target average of observed T1/T2 or T1 alone; repeated Ridge
findings_limitations: Global RMSE 8.442 vs mean 8.294, R² −.062. Different target from baseline or cognitive change; not directly comparable RMSE.

analysis: Supplemental proximity/light/ACC QC, bounded v1–v3 and 11b/12b
cohort: 81 T1 and 61 change table rows; light n≤31, proximity n≤25 correlations
methods_features_outcomes: Bounded modality QC; direct 24h extraction, nine recommended additions; separate midpoint T1 extraction
findings_limitations: Largest direct non-keyboard saved coefficient: proximity raw-row count vs Global r=.503, n=25 (technical intensity; no p/q/CI). Night light rho=−.483, n=9. 11b/12b builder itself trains no models; T1 24h additions are not midpoint changes.

analysis: Empirical two-keyboard-feature Global model
cohort: 81; both observed 62
methods_features_outcomes: Preselected word-completion/IQR directions; equal-weight and positive Ridge, 5-fold ×20
findings_limitations: Positive Ridge RMSE 8.561 vs 8.664 mean; R² −.007. Same-cohort outcome-informed feature/direction selection limits claimed CV validity.

analysis: Empirical extremes (1;4) sensitivity
cohort: Lowest 20 + highest 20 Global T1 =40
methods_features_outcomes: Extreme-score comparison with fixed two keyboard features and same models
findings_limitations: Word-completion p=.059, IQR p=.064, both q=.967; Ridge RMSE 11.966 vs mean 11.898. Outcome-selected spectrum, no generalization evidence.

analysis: Legacy two-feature keyboard correlations, delta and PCA
cohort: Trimmed T1 pairs 58–64; delta n=31/33; PCA n=47
methods_features_outcomes: Midpoint word-completion/IQR; min/max trim; Spearman, paired Wilcoxon, standardized two-feature PCA
findings_limitations: Word-completion vs Attention rho=−.354 (n60,p=.00546); Global −.342 (p=.00744). Global-change rho .256/.160 (p=.165/.372); PCA PC1 71.47%, not cognition explained.

analysis: USML median-span phenotyping and fixed post-hoc overlays
cohort: 81 source; default n76, 41 features; alternate primary/expanded panels
methods_features_outcomes: Skew log1p, median/IQR scaling, PCA/K-means k2–4; seeds/subsampling; T1/T2/change overlays and follow-up-informed score sensitivity
findings_limitations: Default clusters 11/65, PC1+2 59.09%, silhouette .458; interaction volume dominates. Follow-up-informed baseline is outcome-derived; overlays do not validate prediction.

analysis: USML exposure/technical residualization and quality trimming
cohort: Same reference n76,41 features; trimmed n57
methods_features_outcomes: Exposure-normalized, technical-residualized and quality-tail-trimmed fixed k2 comparisons
findings_limitations: ARI versus original .616 exposure; .00985 residualized; .0610 trimmed. Strong evidence structure depends on measurement; no causal conclusion.

analysis: Global top-5 and domain-specific Ridge-selected USML
cohort: Outcome/panel-specific; Motor cognitive n69, Attention n76 in adjusted follow-up
methods_features_outcomes: Repeated Ridge coefficient ranking; top-five PCA/clusters; cognitive overlays; downstream Motor/Attention adjusted inference
findings_limitations: Selection uses cognition, so large PC/cluster effects are circular exploratory displays. Selection-aware adjusted permutation p=.535 Motor, .762 Attention (100 permutations); bootstrap intervals broad.

analysis: Plugin movement dictionary and T1-only extension
cohort: 81 active; 159 mapped devices; T1-only20 (19 with events)
methods_features_outcomes: Mapped T1–T2 minute/event/day context, confidence≥70 flag; separate data-bounded extension
findings_limitations: 2,013,532 paired-interval events; 569,261 extension events. Phone activity context, not validated movement; extension cannot be pooled as T2 change.

analysis: Plugin-anchored ACC pilots and feature audits
cohort: Initial 2 patients/6 feature-days; attempted all-mapped branch 59 selected, 7 feature device-days
methods_features_outcomes: 24 signal/QC features; median aggregation; technical-correlation audit; initial streaming/archive extraction
findings_limitations: Pilots are incomplete historical snapshots; 12 behavioral/3 sensitivity/9 quality candidates. Technical correlations and median/mean agreement are not cognition correlations.

analysis: Completed patient-sequential ACC and completion audit (Sep 11–14)
cohort: 59 processed;51 with signal;773 device-days/769 patient-days
methods_features_outcomes: 24 features, duplicate/sample/gap QC, median/mean patient aggregation, technical relationships
findings_limitations: All 7,374 candidate device-days handled;6,601 no raw signal;77.40% timestamp duplicates. Four multi-device days need special handling; candidate days conditional on plugin observations.

analysis: Full Model PCA combined digital/ACC (three Sep 20 runs)
cohort: Latest n41,56 features (41 digital+15 ACC);9 paired decliners
methods_features_outcomes: Original, post-hoc subject002 exclusion, domain extension; identical-patient digital/ACC/mean/device panels; frozen projection
findings_limitations: Combined PC1+2 50.26%, clusters6/35; ACC-only clusters4/37 reference-only. Decline-only n9; no validated predictive ACC gain. Source run history retained.

analysis: Full Model PCA domain panels and 3D trend lines
cohort: Baseline n36–41;decline n7–9
methods_features_outcomes: Five outcome-ranked features per domain; separate PCA/projections; geometric 3D lines and in-sample score-plane fits
findings_limitations: PC–cognitive rho reaches .857 in n7–8 decline-selected samples; not a direct feature correlation or held-out prediction. Subject exclusion and selection are outcome/post-hoc informed.

analysis: Keyboard Deep Dive extraction and dictionary
cohort: 141 endpoint windows (81 T1/60 T2);2,657 daily rows;34 features
methods_features_outcomes: Canonical text-state snapshots; 30s burst boundary; timing/volume/correction/variability/circadian/day trend and fragmentation
findings_limitations: True key hold/flight times unavailable; features are proxies. Window names mean first/second clinical-interval halves, not pre-T1/post-T2.

analysis: Keyboard-only supervised, PCA and clustering
cohort: 12 target tasks; outcome n51–81; PCA n66/32 varying features
methods_features_outcomes: Repeated 5-fold×5 mean/Ridge/elastic net/RF; PCA/k2–4
findings_limitations: PCA PC1+2 65.31%; model fit does not establish cognition relationship. Family screen shows small T1 Motor typing-volume gain (10.400 vs 10.526 RMSE) but no general longitudinal gain.

analysis: Keyboard Signal Discovery
cohort: 408 tests:204 T1 +204 change; six candidates n28–33
methods_features_outcomes: Spearman,500 bootstrap,age/sex/education partial ranks; BH per scope; candidate q≤.20
findings_limitations: Six longitudinal candidates, five with executive function and one attention; none meets discovery q<.05. Largest discovery raw rho .593 afternoon/EF; recovery −.589 EF. Not independent evidence.

analysis: Keyboard Signal Validation
cohort: Six selected associations n28–33; reliability T1 n15–16/T2 n18
methods_features_outcomes: Baseline/recording/device adjusted ranks; LOO, outlier check,2,000 permutations; daily first/last14-day ICC
findings_limitations: All six LOO signs stable; selected-six permutation q≤.0085. Recording adjustment attenuates; best afternoon/EF partial rho=.508,p=.0222,q=.133. T2 ICC lower; post-selection tests are not independent validation.

analysis: T2 reliability and coverage sensitivity
cohort: 60 paired keyboard-window patients;seven-day threshold associations n20
methods_features_outcomes: Predefined7/14/28 active-day and500/2000 snapshot/interval gates; comparable observed-day periods
findings_limitations: Timing changes stronger in ≥7-day subset (evening/EF rho .702,n20), but limited coverage and poor T2 reliability remain. Old separate medians have different denominators.

analysis: First/last-third raw re-extraction and midpoint sensitivity
cohort: 61 paired source;both thirds≥7d n19;≥14d n7;≥28d n2
methods_features_outcomes: 34 features from first/last calendar thirds;middle excluded;Spearman/bootstrap/FDR and same-patient midpoint comparison
findings_limitations: Strongest saved direct association rho .784 morning/attention in midpoint comparator n18; corresponding thirds rho .573. Strict threshold association tables empty due insufficient n.

analysis: Keyboard count audit and canonical snapshot correction
cohort: 141 midpoint/122 thirds windows;109/86 paired-count rows;v2 cohort19
methods_features_outcomes: Shared count invariant;duplicate/multistream tests;separate adjusted-correlation rerun with canonical observation counts
findings_limitations: Zero per-window count violations. Misleading independent medians and raw-row labeling identified. Corrected 272 planned/270 estimable tests: no FDR finding,min q=.836; originals preserved.

analysis: Expanded keyboard general-model integration (Oct 20)
cohort: T1 n71–81;change n51–61;61 existing/89 expanded candidate features +4 technical covariates
methods_features_outcomes: Raw Phase11/12 wide bank;replace six keyboard features with34;identical-fold nested Ridge,3×5 outer/3 inner CV;all8 outcomes
findings_limitations: Global RMSE worsens10.47→11.03 T1 and6.40→8.19 change;T1 memory improves16.54→14.80 but mean13.80. All fold-mean R² negative. This bank omits newer raw-ACC block and is not the exact historical primary37 model.

analysis: Backup/conversion, dashboards, graph and manuscript infrastructure
cohort: Operational manifests; no inferential cohort
methods_features_outcomes: Resumable motion archive, selected-table Parquet conversion,Streamlit knowledge graph and provenance
findings_limitations: Operational achievements are separate from findings. Four-table raw-motion Parquet conversion is not established by model outputs; external archive integrity not rechecked in this review.
